differences.a_observable: The camera perspective is lower and closer to the blue card, showing less of the surrounding grid.
differences.b_observable: The camera is higher and further back, showing more of the grid at a steeper angle.
differences.fix: Adjust camera height, distance, and pitch to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast by the blue card onto the white surface are soft and highly diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are sharp and dark with high contrast edges.
differences.fix: Increase the light source size or adjust shadow diffusion settings.

differences.a_observable: The blue card has a matte, slightly desaturated royal blue color.
differences.b_observable: The blue card is highly saturated and vibrant.
differences.fix: Reduce the saturation and brightness of the blue card material.

differences.a_observable: The top and bottom areas of the frame are softly blurred due to shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The entire frame is uniformly sharp, lacking depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field with a wider aperture focused on the center card.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position and rotation to match the reference perspective, and enable depth of field with soft shadow rendering.
